description.narrative: THE OBJECTIVE OF THE PROGRAM IS TO IMPROVE AND MAINTAIN THE MAIN CORRIDORS OF TRANSPORTATION (HIGHWAYS AND RAILWAYS). THE PHYSICAL GOALS ARE: TO UPGRADE 2300 KM OF ROADS, PROVIDE MAJOR MAINTENANCE FOR 2000 KM AND ROUTINE MAINTENANCE FOR 16000 KM OF ROADS; AND RESTORE 1000 KM OF RAILWAY AND 100 BRIDGES. A LINE OF CREDIT FOR PRIVATE SECTOR INVESTMENTS IN TRANSPORTATION WILL BE PROVIDED.
